change: Skip retired-record scan under mu when retained handles == live threads; no new state/allocation/API, original join and retirement slow path unchanged.
invariant: A worker decrements num_threads and sets its retired flag while holding mu. New thread record push/count increment also hold mu. The equality proves all retained records are live. A concurrent reaper extracts only retired records under the same mutex.
method: Exactly two independent process pairs AB then BA. Each shape prestarts 1 or32 actual busy pool workers gated on an external condition variable. Times8192 public spawn_blocking submissions including job/JoinState allocation and storing pre-reserved handles. Releases gate, joins every result/checksum, then shutdown and live/handle zero checks outside timer. Not offload round-trip or external peer rank.
shape_order_note: 1-worker shape precedes32 in every process, so allocator warmth differs across shapes; do not compare their absolute latencies to infer thread-count scaling.
